name: model-router
description: Routes each turn and subagent to a model tier and reasoning effort using a classifier behind any server that speaks POST /v1/classify (model-router-api on Cloudflare Workers AI today), falling back to the engine's built-in classifier.

provider.title: Classifier backend
provider.description: auto uses the API when apiUrl and apiSecret are both set and the built-in classifier otherwise; api asks for the API and warns when it is not configured; builtin always uses the built-in classifier

apiUrl.title: Classifier API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of a server that speaks POST /v1/classify (e.g. https://model-router-api.<subdomain>.workers.dev), no trailing path

apiSecret.title: Classifier API secret
apiSecret.description: Bearer secret the API expects; the Worker's ROUTER_SECRET

fastModel.title: Fast tier model
fastModel.description: Sent when the classifier rates the work as needing little judgment. An alias from the model list in hooks/models.ts, or a full model id

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier model
balancedModel.description: Sent for everyday engineering work of moderate difficulty. An alias or a full model id

deepModel.title: Deep tier model
deepModel.description: Sent for demanding or high-stakes work, and whenever the risk threshold is crossed. An alias or a full model id

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Upgrade confidence
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Lowest classifier confidence (0 to 1) needed to move to a more capable model or higher effort; an answer with no confidence always may

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Downgrade confidence
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Lowest classifier confidence (0 to 1) needed to move to a cheaper model or lower effort; an answer with no confidence never may

riskyThreshold.title: Risk threshold
riskyThreshold.description: Above this probability that the act is risky, the deep tier and at least high effort are forced

contextMessages.title: Context messages
contextMessages.description: How many recent messages go with a main-loop prompt; 0 sends the prompt alone

contextChars.title: Context characters
contextChars.description: Character budget for those messages; the oldest are dropped first

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Choose a model for every new subagent from its own classification (forked subagents inherit their parent's model instead)

respectAgentModels.title: Respect named subagent models
respectAgentModels.description: Keep a model the Agent tool named for a subagent unless risk forces an upgrade. Covers only the Agent tool's model parameter; a model set in an agent's definition isn't visible to the router

routeMainEffort.title: Route main-loop effort
routeMainEffort.description: Set the main loop's reasoning effort from the classification; needs the API, since the built-in classifier gives no effort

routeMainModel.title: Route main-loop model
routeMainModel.description: Let the router swap the main conversation's model between tiers. Each swap starts the prompt cache afresh, which costs time and tokens, so leave this off unless you want it

timeoutMs.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Budget in milliseconds for each classification; a slower answer is ignored and routing is skipped for that request

warmUp.title: Warm up the classifier
warmUp.description: When an interactive session starts, send one throwaway classification in the background so the first prompt doesn't wait on a cold classifier. Costs one classifier call per session

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Log the setup, each classification and each routing choice, and show the status line; warnings and failures are logged either way
